sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 ---
Coram :Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Anubha Rawat Choudhary
---
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Raja Ravi Shekhar Singh, Advocate
The learned counsel for the petitioner is present.

2. The records of the case reveal that the petitioner (husband) who has been convicted under section 498A of Indian Penal Code has given the address of opposite party no.2 (wife) as that of his own address.
The records reveal that the notice issued to opposite party no.2 has been served with a note by her husband that she does not reside there.
It further appears from the office note that the note regarding notice not served has been prepared on 05.11.2019 but it is not clear as to why the case was not listed thereafter.

3. Today when the case is taken up, the learned counsel for the petitioner prays for and is granted time till 18.06.2024 to take steps for fresh service of notice under speed post as well as ordinary process upon the opposite party no.2 at her present and correct address.

4. Post this case on 25.07.2024 awaiting service report.
5.
Office is directed to prepare office note with regard to the service of notice.
(Anubha Rawat Choudhary, J.) Saurav Santosh Mahto vs The State Of Jharkhand And Another on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59749009/
